name: Wesh Aljawab
summary: Wesh Aljawab is an Arabic interactive trivia and social competition game. It challenges players' knowledge through a series of fast-paced questions and cultural challenges. The game is designed for both individual play and social interaction, allowing users to compete in real-time, track their progress on global leaderboards, and unlock achievements. With a focus on Arabic culture and general knowledge, Wesh Aljawab provides an engaging educational and entertainment experience for the MENA region.
